title: Isolated multi-project staged edit
summary: Edit a DWG in an agent-owned AutoCAD process and shadow copy, verify the geometry, diff against the untouched source, commit safely and deliver the measured result.

notes: The session uses DispatchEx and an agent-owned PID; it never attaches to the user's AutoCAD window.
The source is staged before any edit. project_diff_staged compares the source and shadow copy, and project_commit_staged refuses to overwrite a locked source.
The line step is a small explicit example edit; replace it with the typed geometry operations the actual requirements call for.

drawing.description: Existing source DWG; it remains untouched.

requirements.description: Typed source requirements for preflight and geometry verification.

delivery_dir.description: Directory for the verified delivery bundle.

steps.purpose: Start an isolated AutoCAD process, stage the source and open only the shadow copy.
steps.evidence: Agent-owned PID, window mode and source/staged paths.

steps.purpose: Resolve all requirements before changing geometry.
steps.evidence: ready, spec_hash and every open item.

steps.purpose: Apply one explicit example edit to the staged drawing.
steps.evidence: The created entity handle on the staged document.

steps.purpose: Measure every requirement on the edited CAD geometry.
steps.evidence: accepted, status and requirement rows with handles and measured values.

steps.purpose: Run all applicable drafting checks over the staged drawing.
steps.evidence: The complete issue list; an empty list is required before delivery.

steps.purpose: Review exactly what changed against the untouched source.
steps.evidence: Changed, added and removed geometry with source and staged paths.

steps.purpose: Publish the staged DWG to a separate deliverable without overwriting the source.
steps.evidence: output_path, overwrote_source=false and lock-safe commit result.

steps.purpose: Export, reopen and measure the delivery artifact again.
steps.evidence: status=success, manifest.json and saved-file geometry acceptance.

postconditions.says: The edit ran in a shadow copy.
No requirement was left open before drawing.
Every requirement passed on the geometry.
The user's source was not overwritten.
The saved delivery was reopened and accepted.
